headline: CU Chhatra Dal leader show-caused for protesting fuel price hike on Facebook
summary: Sazzad Hossain Hridoy, organizing secretary of the Chittagong University unit, must explain why disciplinary action should not be taken against him.
details: Sazzad Hossain Hridoy, the organizing secretary of the Chittagong University unit of Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, has been issued a show-cause notice by the organization's central committee.
The action follows a Facebook post where Hridoy registered his protest against the recent hike in fuel prices, noting that most BNP programs he joined were against such price increases.
The notice, signed by office secretary Md Jahangir Alam, asks Hridoy to explain why permanent disciplinary action should not be taken for allegedly violating organizational discipline.
Hridoy has been ordered to appear at the central office within 48 hours to submit a written explanation to the President and General Secretary of Chhatra Dal.
In his post's comments, Hridoy mentioned that Middle East war-driven international oil price hikes led to a Tk 22,000 crore loss for the country.
Hridoy stated he remains loyal to the organization and will provide the required explanation within the stipulated timeframe.
caption:
A student leader is facing disciplinary action for simply posting his protest against fuel price hikes on Facebook.

Sazzad Hossain Hridoy, the organizing secretary of the Chittagong University unit of Bangladesh Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal, has been issued a show-cause notice by the organization's central committee.

The action follows a Facebook post where Hridoy registered his protest against the recent hike in fuel prices, noting that most BNP programs he joined were against such price increases.

The notice, signed by office secretary Md Jahangir Alam, asks Hridoy to explain why permanent disciplinary action should not be taken for allegedly violating organizational discipline.

Hridoy has been ordered to appear at the central office within 48 hours to submit a written explanation to the President and General Secretary of Chhatra Dal.

In his post's comments, Hridoy mentioned that Middle East war-driven international oil price hikes led to a Tk 22,000 crore loss for the country.

Hridoy stated he remains loyal to the organization and will provide the required explanation within the stipulated timeframe.

headline: Police seek 7-day remand for MP Gazi Nazrul and first wife
summary: The Satkhira-4 MP and his first wife were arrested for allegedly inciting the second wife to commit suicide.
details: Police have requested a 7-day remand for Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda Islam, in connection with a case involving the death of the MP's second wife.
The victim, 19-year-old Mariyam Khatun, was found dead in a flat at the NAM Building in Dhaka. The flat belonged to the MP, where he lived with both his first and second wives.
Mariyam's father, Masum Billah, filed a case at the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar police station, accusing the MP, his first wife, and Mariyam's uncle, Obaidur Rahman, of inciting her to commit suicide.
Police arrested the MP and his first wife on Monday morning and brought them before the court. The third accused, Obaidur Rahman, remains at large.
The investigation is ongoing, and the body of Mariyam Khatun is being handed over to her family following a post-mortem examination.
caption:
An MP and his first wife are in custody after the second wife was found dead in their shared flat.

Police have requested a 7-day remand for Satkhira-4 MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda Islam, in connection with a case involving the death of the MP's second wife.

The victim, 19-year-old Mariyam Khatun, was found dead in a flat at the NAM Building in Dhaka. The flat belonged to the MP, where he lived with both his first and second wives.

Mariyam's father, Masum Billah, filed a case at the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar police station, accusing the MP, his first wife, and Mariyam's uncle, Obaidur Rahman, of inciting her to commit suicide.

Police arrested the MP and his first wife on Monday morning and brought them before the court. The third accused, Obaidur Rahman, remains at large.

The investigation is ongoing, and the body of Mariyam Khatun is being handed over to her family following a post-mortem examination.
